description_en: Queries the test results of an API in DataService Studio
name: GetDataServiceApiTest

parameters.help_en: The Id of the test. TestDataServiceApi is executed asynchronously after the API is called and the test Id is returned. You can also use ListDataServiceApiTest to obtain the latest test Id
parameters.help_zh: 测试Id。TestDataServiceApi接口调用以后异步执行，同时返回测试Id。也可以通过ListDataServiceApiTest获取最近的测试Id
parameters.name: test_id
